item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. Preventing that means stopping its development—not racing to build it first.

2. Superintelligence is not merely a powerful new technology. Built with anything like today’s methods, it will cause human extinction. No company or country should be permitted to create it.

3. We cannot make an extinction race safe by asking competitors to be careful. If anyone builds superintelligence using current approaches, humanity dies. Governments must ban its development.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 116 words

If anyone builds superintelligence using anything like today’s techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We are organizing our work around that fact. The systems now being developed are not on a path to safe superintelligence: they are opaque, unpredictable, and built through methods that do not give humanity reliable control. More scaling, more data, and more computing power will not solve this basic problem. They will bring us closer to creating an intelligence greater than our own without knowing how to keep it aligned with human survival. That is why we are focusing our communications and policy work on the necessary response: governments must prohibit the development of superintelligence before a company or state builds it.
